response.sql: SELECT status, avg_remaining, avg_overspend_rate, avg_remaining / AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () as remaining_normalized FROM (SELECT status, AVG(event_avg_remaining) as avg_remaining, AVG(event_avg_overspend_rate) as avg_overspend_rate FROM (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) as event_avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / b.amount) as event_avg_overspend_rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status) events_by_status GROUP BY status) status_summary
